title: Engineering Manager, Security Platform: Authentication
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Engineering Manager on GitLab's Authentication team, you'll build and lead a team of engineers in Bangalore who own how users, applications, tokens, and artificial intelligence (AI) agents sign in to GitLab. At GitLab, we see our team as our product. You'll need to be technically credible in authentication protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML). Your main focus will be hiring well, growing your engineers, and helping the team deliver on commitments that other parts of GitLab depend on. You'll guide your team's work on OAuth across Cells, global identities, token consolidation, and moving authentication out of the Ruby on Rails monolith onto GATE, GitLab's new authentication and authorization platform. You'll manage these multi-quarter programs with fixed deadlines and many dependent teams.

What you'll do

  • Hire, onboard, and grow a team of senior and intermediate engineers in Bangalore, working with talent acquisition during a high-volume hiring period.
  • Own delivery for your team's part of the authentication roadmap: plan in milestones, track risks early, and communicate clearly when a date is at risk and what would change it.
  • Work with your Staff Engineer and Product Manager to turn architecture decisions into shippable, feature-flagged increments.
  • Protect your team's focus. Manage requests from other teams through one intake path, and make trade-offs visible to leadership.
  • Coordinate with the GATE Core, GATE Infra, Authorization, and Tenant Scale (Cells and Organizations) teams across India, Europe, and the Americas.
  • Make sure the team runs what it builds, including on-call coverage, incident response for authentication issues, rate limits, and production readiness for new services.
  • Build a team culture where security comes first, decisions are written down, and code review is thorough and kind.
  • Give clear, regular feedback, run career conversations, and handle performance issues early.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience as an engineering manager of backend or platform teams, including hiring and growing senior engineers.
  • A background as an engineer in identity, authentication, or security systems, with enough depth in OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and JSON Web Tokens to review designs and ask probing questions.
  • Experience delivering complex, multi-team programs against fixed dates, including migrations that must not disrupt existing customers.
  • Experience running production services, including on-call coverage, incident response, and reliability work.
  • Working knowledge of Ruby on Rails or Go.
  • Experience building a new team or growing one quickly while keeping the hiring bar high.
  • Clear, concise written English and comfort leading a team in an all-remote, asynchronous company across time zones.

About the team

We're part of the Security Platform stage, alongside Authorization, GATE Core, GATE Infra, Secrets Manager, and other security teams. You'll partner closely with our existing Authentication engineers in Europe and the Americas.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

  • Hands-on Marketo experience, including smart lists, segmentation, engagement programs, dynamic content, and automated workflows.
  • Experience using email and funnel performance data to recommend and make improvements, not only to report results.
  • Strong written communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional coordination skills, with the confidence to bring a point of view to partners.

The Lifecycle Marketing team creates personalized, scalable programs to engage prospects, customers, and users at every stage of their journey. Our goal is to showcase GitLab's value, empower effective product use, and drive meaningful connections through touchpoints like sales meetings, events, and webinars. We own the email channel, one of GitLab's most effective tools for communicating with our diverse audience of developers, IT professionals, and business leaders.

We operate at the intersection of data, creativity, and user experience, with team members dedicated to nurturing prospects, converting self-service users, and expanding relationships with existing customers. This is an exciting time to join: we're growing our investment in lifecycle as a revenue driver, and you'll have real input in shaping how we build and scale these programs.

The team works collaboratively with cross-functional partners in Design, Product Management, Business and other Engineering teams to quickly brainstorm, prototype, develop, and deliver high quality product experiences.

title: Engineering Manager, Marketing Technology
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

THE COMMUNITY YOU WILL JOIN

Airbnb's Marketing Technology organization builds the infrastructure that powers how we reach and connect with guests and hosts around the world — from audience segmentation and campaign orchestration to last-mile delivery and real-time insights. Our engineers work at the intersection of scale, reliability, and product impact, building platforms that carry billions of messages each year across email, SMS, push, and WhatsApp. We are deeply committed to building AI-natively: agents and LLM-powered automation are becoming core to how we build, operate, and improve our systems.

You'll lead two closely partnered teams that together own Airbnb's communications platform end to end. The Orchestration team builds the systems that let marketing and product teams design and run personalized, event- and list-triggered customer journeys at Airbnb scale. The Delivery team owns the last mile — routing every notification through the right provider, tracking it to a terminal state, and managing contact preferences and vendor relationships. Both teams collaborate deeply with audience segmentation, content, ML, and data engineering teams, as well as product partners across the company.

THE DIFFERENCE YOU WILL MAKE

As the Engineering Manager for this team, you will be the primary technical leader for the systems that decide whether a message reaches a guest or host — and when. You'll set the technical direction, own roadmap execution, and build the kind of team culture where engineers grow and do the best work of their careers, including through deep, genuine adoption of AI-native engineering practices.

The platform is mid-transformation. We are consolidating legacy and next-generation messaging flows onto a single unified path, moving platform health from component metrics to business-impact signals such as campaign delivery SLAs and burn rate, and building end-to-end observability so any owner — human or agent — can answer "what happened to notification X for user Y" in minutes. At the same time, both teams are standing up agentic capabilities: an agent-driven orchestration layer, end-to-end lifecycle testing agents, smart notification scheduling, and AI-assisted on-call triage. You will be the leader who ensures these systems ship with the rigor, reliability, and operational maturity that production-grade messaging and agentic systems demand.

Your leadership will directly determine how reliably Airbnb communicates with its community, how confidently partner teams can build on the platform, and how effectively this team leads Marketing Technology's shift toward AI-native engineering.

A TYPICAL DAY

  • Lead planning, roadmap reviews, and cross-team syncs for Delivery and Orchestration, keeping delivery on track and stakeholders well-informed
  • Run 1:1s with engineers across both teams, with intentional focus on career growth, technical skill development, and early identification of blockers
  • Serve as the primary engineering point of contact for cross-team dependencies — fielding requests from product teams across Airbnb and making clear, reasoned prioritization calls
  • Partner with the Product Manager to sequence the roadmap across journey orchestration, bulk campaign sends, and delivery infrastructure
  • Drive technical strategy for end-to-end observability and SLA-driven delivery: campaign-level delivery tracking, health-gated ramping, dynamic pacing against budgets, and automatic provider failover
  • Oversee the design, delivery, and operational health of production agentic systems: agent-driven orchestration, lifecycle testing agents, smart scheduling, and LLM-assisted on-call triage
  • Champion AI-native development practices across both teams — from AI-assisted coding and review to agents in CI/CD, on-call response, and delivery anomaly detection
  • Own the health and operational maturity of both teams: daytime and 24/7 on-call programs, blameless incident retrospectives, SLO definitions, runbook quality, and third-party messaging vendor escalations
  • Represent the communications platform in org-wide planning cycles and contribute to the broader Marketing Technology engineering strategy

YOUR EXPERTISE

Required

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years in an engineering management role leading platform or infrastructure teams
  • Demonstrated AI-native engineering mindset — you use AI tools daily in your own work, have led teams in genuinely adopting AI-assisted development, and have strong opinions about where agents add real leverage vs. hype
  • Experience leading teams that have designed, built, and operated production-grade agentic systems — autonomous or semi-autonomous agent pipelines, LLM-orchestrated workflows, or multi-agent architectures handling real production traffic
  • Strong technical foundation in high-throughput distributed systems: event-driven architectures, message queues and streaming (Kafka or similar), workflow orchestration engines (Temporal or similar), and multi-provider integrations — able to engage credibly in architecture and design conversations
  • Track record of running reliable, customer-facing production services with defined SLOs, including on-call programs, incident management, and operational excellence across teams of varying size and seniority
  • Demonstrated experience managing engineers across a range of seniority levels, including early-career engineers, with a track record of meaningful career growth outcomes
  • Experience owning cross-team platform relationships: managing inbound dependency requests, negotiating priorities, and communicating commitments with confidence
  • Track record of delivering complex, multi-quarter technical roadmaps — including large-scale migrations or legacy system consolidations — in fast-moving environments

Preferred

  • Experience with notification, messaging, or communications infrastructure at scale — email, SMS, push, or WhatsApp delivery.
  • Experience with customer journey orchestration, marketing automation, or lifecycle messaging platforms
  • Hands-on familiarity with agent frameworks and orchestration tooling (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, Autogen, Temporal, or similar) and practical knowledge of where these systems break down in production
  • Experience building end-to-end observability and business-impact alerting for multi-hop asynchronous pipelines
  • Experience managing teams that own 24/7 on-call rotations and production services with external SLAs or vendor dependencies

We expect team members to be available during core collaboration hours in their time zone and to participate in occasional onsite gatherings as the team and org schedule them, typically 2–4 times per year.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Brand Creative Team is evolving and elevating how the Robinhood brand shows up and reaches people – capturing attention, earning trust, and driving our next phase of growth.

Design has always given Robinhood an edge, and it matters more than ever as we continue to grow.

As Group Creative Director, Design, you will lead the Robinhood brand identity and the design system behind it, setting the direction for everything from campaigns to product launches and events. You'll push the brand forward, hold the work to a world-class bar, and make sure it scales as Robinhood reaches more people.

This role is based in our New York, NY or Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

  • Set the design vision. Define where the Robinhood visual identity goes next and what world-class looks like across brand, campaigns, motion, product and IRL. Turn a clear point of view into design that puts Robinhood at the forefront of the best design brands in the world.
  • Own the brand design system. Lead how we define, document and evolve the identity so it stays ownable, flexible and cohesive everywhere it shows up. Build guidelines and workflows that work for the people using them and hold up at scale.
  • Modernize how we make. Put AI at the center of how we design. Lead the charge on evaluating, piloting and standardizing the tools and AI-forward workflows that transform concepting, production and localization.
  • Raise the bar on the work. Hold a high standard for craft and ideas, from concept through execution. Give clear feedback, don't let good enough ship, and keep agency partners and timelines moving.
  • Move brand and product forward together. Partner with Product Design to build best-in-class experiences where brand and product feel like one. Make every moment so compelling people want to come back.
  • Partner with the business. Work with marketing, growth and other teams to keep the brand tied to business goals. Turn goals and data into design decisions, and bring senior leaders along.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in design, art direction and brand storytelling, with 4+ years in senior design roles at a consumer brand, fintech or agency.
  • A world-class portfolio of brand-level work and system-level thinking across brand, marketing and product.
  • Demonstrated experience at the forefront of technology, specifically use of AI to level up design output and quality.
  • Experience leading designers and multidisciplinary teams, including freelancers and agencies.

Skills and mindset

  • Visionary and business-minded. You have a clear creative vision and the conviction to set direction. You understand how design drives the business and turn goals and data into work that delivers impact.

You will personally build and execute outbound channels like LinkedIn, email, and outreach, while directing central marketing and Concierge teams for other channels. title: Engineering Manager, Agent Security Partnerships
region: New York City, NY / Seattle, WA / San Francisco, CA
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Agent Security's mission is to safely increase how much of the world's work agents can do, starting inside Anthropic.

Claude now writes and ships code, runs experiments and acts on people's behalf, for hours at a time. How much more it can take on depends on how safely it can operate. If, in the worst case, an agent misbehaves, Anthropic and the public may bear the consequences. Our mandate is to mitigate this risk, and Anthropic’s mission depends on it.

The Partnerships team pairs security engineers with the teams at Anthropic that build Claude, build agents and rely on agents. Those teams are our partners. When a team wants its agents to do more, we threat model the plan with them and build the controls together. Most of this has no playbook, so we have often created new controls from first principles. The ones that work become part of our toolbox, spread to other teams, and in some cases ship in our products.

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead this team of security engineers. This is first and foremost a people leadership role. Few have secured agents at scale, especially at a frontier lab, so we don't expect you to have done it. We do expect you to have led security engineering teams, and we care most about how you lead people and reason about security.

This role operates at the frontier. Each model generation, and each new harness, brings new challenges. The number of teams building on agents keeps growing, and partner teams won't always agree with your calls. In return, you will have the chance to directly contribute to making transformative AI go well, which is the heart of our mission.

Key responsibilities

  • Hire, mentor and grow senior and staff security engineers, and raise the bar as the team scales
  • Set the team's investment strategy, deciding which teams get embedded engineers, and for how long, as demand outgrows the team
  • Support the team through high-stakes safety and security calls made under uncertainty and on tight timelines
  • Balance long-term investment in shared controls against partner teams’ immediate asks
  • Deliver large security migrations across all of Anthropic
  • Work through difficult tradeoffs with partner teams in ways that build trust and understanding

Representative Projects

In the past, the team has:

  • Invented a new kind of classifier-based control for agents partnering with an internal team to develop and roll it out
  • Co-built a sandbox with a product team, choosing what to enforce first so that adoption stuck
  • Defined the security standards for running agents across the company and partnered with many different teams on how to hit these standards

Minimum qualifications

  • Excellent people management skills. You've hired, developed and managed senior and staff engineers, grown engineers into staff or lead roles, and kept a team delivering through changing priorities.
  • Deep security management experience. You've managed security engineering teams and answered to executives for risk and tradeoffs.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills. You've explained hard tradeoffs to executives and to engineers in plain words.
  • Resilience, emotional awareness, low ego and high empathy
  • Experience leading large migrations and highly cross-functional work
  • A willingness to dive into the details to tie-break complex trade-offs without any clear answer, and the ability to stand by these decisions

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience embedding security engineers with product, infrastructure or research teams, or running a security partnerships team
  • Agent security or AI/ML security experience
  • Familiarity with AI safety concepts and research
  • Leading in hypergrowth

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Director of Sales, Named (Toronto)
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Toronto, Ontario

About the Department

The Cloudflare sales team is comprised of Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together to acquire customers and help them adopt Cloudflare technologies to create great Internet-enabled experiences.

The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real security and performance challenges while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free services to millions in our community.

What you'll do

We are looking for an experienced Sales Director to lead and grow the Enterprise and Public Sector business in Ontario with responsibility for driving Cloudflare's revenue and brand awareness in the region. Based in the Greater Toronto Area and reporting directly to the Canadian VP, the Sales Director will require both strategic and hands-on leadership skills to lead the go-to-market strategy, including hiring, leading and growing the sales team, building pipeline, and driving sales to grow the business in the region. In this role you will work actively with prospects, customers, partners and field sales professionals to sell and close deals to build the region.

Additional responsibilities will include:

  • Design, build and execute strategies for the Region in collaboration with regional and global functional leaders
  • Lead and grow the Central Canada Enterprise and Public Sector (Named) sales team working with global functional leaders and recruiting resources.
  • Serve as the local point person for all Named functions in Canada including customer relationships, pipeline development, account management, sales and partnerships.
  • Drive business cadence for forecast calls, business reviews, deal reviews, customer account reviews, weekly team meetings and periodic company-wide meetings.
  • Lead programs and campaigns - working across sales, marketing, customer success, solutions engineering, business development and support - to drive awareness, pipeline and sales results.
  • Drive sales growth through successful leadership, organizational planning, customer service and outstanding execution of all regional sales and go-to-market strategies.
  • Represent Cloudflare as the single point of contact for all Regional operational concerns, ensuring proper and timely escalation and resolution.
  • Ensure that corporate policy and regulatory initiatives are consistently applied and followed by team members.
  • Outstanding leadership that inspires interpersonal effectiveness, develops talent and effects change. Willing and able to be a “doer” and “influencer”.
  • Represent Cloudflare at external conferences and events.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • 10+ years of direct B2B sales experience, selling to large Enterprise accounts
  • 5+ years of direct sales management experience leading an Enterprise field sales team.
  • Experience managing and coaching long, complex, high value Enterprise sales cycles
  • Experience selling into top tier accounts in key verticals including Financial Services, Retail, Industrial. Energy and Media.
  • Understanding of IaaS, Networking and Information Security services.
  • Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science or MIS a plus).
  • Strong leadership, presentation, interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills.
  • Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in the UK.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25–30% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way across the DACH region.

description:

The Startups segment serves fast-moving, high-growth companies that are often building new products, workflows, and businesses directly on top of AI. These customers move quickly, operate with high ambiguity, and expect practical, creative, and technically rigorous partnership.

title: Head of Ecosystem
description:
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We aim to empower developers by providing a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

We're looking for a Head of Ecosystem to lead the teams that make Supabase the backend for the platforms and tools developers already use. That covers AI app builders and coding agents, integrations with the developer tools teams rely on, and the Supabase Marketplace. You'll build this org from the ground up and shape how Supabase extends beyond its own platform.

You'll also drive hiring, onboarding, and career development while maintaining high engineering standards.

What you'll own:

  • Build and lead a new engineering org across platform partners, integrations, and Marketplace, hiring EMs and engineers as it grows

  • Own the technical relationship with the platforms building on Supabase, from integration health to escalations

  • Set and maintain clear roadmaps that balance partner needs with platform priorities

  • Partner with Product, Partnerships, and Sales to define and execute our ecosystem strategy

  • Ship a unified, self-serve surface for integrations and Marketplace

  • Maintain high engineering standards: roadmap hygiene, issue tracking, on-call, incident response, and responsiveness to partners

What you bring:

  • Proven experience leading multiple engineering teams, including managing other managers

  • Experience building and running platform, API, or integration surfaces that third parties depend on in production

  • Technical credibility with partner engineering teams, and the judgment to say no

  • Experience building teams or an org from a small base, including hiring and developing engineering managers

  • Strong organizational and execution skills: setting roadmaps, driving accountability, and keeping teams moving under uncertainty

  • Experience managing remote, globally distributed teams

  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills, especially with Product and commercial teams

  • Collaborative, low-ego, and adaptable

Bonus points if you:

  • Have experience with OAuth, platform APIs, or app marketplaces

  • Have worked on a developer platform's partner or app ecosystem

  • Have worked with AI app builders or coding agents

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

title: Global Head of Renewals, Product & Engineering
region: San Francisco, CA / New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's customers renew on a mix of committed and consumption contracts, and the number of renewals is growing faster than any team of people could keep pace with. We don't want to answer that by hiring hundreds of renewal managers. We want renewals to run as a system: Claude and agents do most of the work, from spotting risk to drafting the offer to closing a standard renewal in product, and people step in where judgment, negotiation or relationships matter.

You'll design, build and run that system. You'll own the renewal outcome for the business globally and the product and technology that delivers it. You'll lead a small team of builders and the human layer, internal specialists and outsourced partners, that handles what agents can't yet. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Deal Desk, Finance, Billing and Product Engineering.

This is a Claude-first role. You'll use Claude every day to do your own work, and the renewal function will be one of the clearest examples inside Anthropic of what AI-run operations look like.

What you'll own in your first year

  • The design of the renewal system: which work agents run end to end, which work goes to a person, and the handoff rules between them.
  • A standard renewal that needs no person: a Claude-generated offer in product ahead of term end, accepted and provisioned automatically, with anything outside guidance routed to a seller with a recommended quote.
  • The data the system runs on: contract, commit burndown and usage data clean enough that agents and people trust it, built with Billing and Finance.
  • Early-warning signals for consumption risk and commitment shortfall, and what happens when one fires.
  • The human layer: how internal specialists, outsourced partners and account teams work around the agents, and the measures they're held to.
  • The next large renewal cycles, run with fewer manual steps per renewal than today.
  • Weekly renewal and retention forecasts grounded in usage and contract data.
  • Executive renewal conversations on the largest and most complex accounts, alongside account teams.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • Owned renewal, retention or post-sale outcomes at large scale, either running the function or leading the product or service that runs it for others.
  • Led product or engineering teams and shipped software or agents that took over work people used to do.
  • Run or designed a blended model of people, outsourced partners and software, and know where each one breaks.
  • A working grasp of renewal economics: committed and consumption contracts, discount guidance, and the term, billing and CRM data behind them.
  • Built things yourself recently. You can prototype with Claude, read the data and pressure-test an agent's output without waiting on someone else.
  • Set direction with senior executives and held cross-functional teams to it without direct authority.

Strong candidates may also have

  • Usage-based pricing and commit burndown experience.
  • Built health, churn or early-warning models that changed what teams did.
  • Worked at a company whose product runs renewals, retention or quote-to-cash for its customers.
  • Worked across regions, including marketplace or cloud-partner billing.
  • Written or spoken publicly about agent-led customer operations.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$350,000—$500,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. region: San Francisco, CA / New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

There are close to a billion knowledge workers in the world, and only a small fraction of them have worked with AI that makes them better at what they do. In the enterprise, reaching the rest depends on the IT, security, and business leaders who decide whether to adopt AI, and the admins who decide how it's deployed, governed, and scaled across their organizations. They ask hard questions before they say yes, and this role owns how we answer them.

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own positioning for Claude's core knowledge-work products (Chat, Cowork, and the broader non-coding suite) for enterprise decision makers and admins. You'll work across the areas that matter most to enterprise customers today: security and observability, workspace management and deployment controls, and pricing and packaging. You'll own the materials that help a decision maker or admin understand what's possible, roll Claude out with confidence, and make the case internally, including product launches, the website, pitch decks, battlecards, persona narratives, pricing and packaging story, and admin communications. Beyond making the case for adopting AI, you'll help the people accountable for deploying it do that safely, and show them exactly how to put it to work across their organizations.

This is an individual-contributor role for someone who loves the hands-on work of product marketing, on products with enormous, established usage and a fast launch cadence. You'll write the positioning doc, build the battlecard, and ship the persona work yourself, and you'll use Claude to keep it all current, so the teams that depend on it can trust it.

This role is for you if you've owned the full product marketing stack for a widely used enterprise product and know how to speak credibly to business, IT, and security audiences. You probably also turn your own PMM work into systems rather than one-off documents, and you want your writing to be the reason enterprise decision makers and admins say yes to rolling out and scaling Claude.

Key responsibilities

  • Define the story that earns enterprise trust. Own the positioning and messaging house for Chat, Cowork, and Claude's core knowledge-work products for admins, so every deck, campaign, and piece of content makes the same case for adopting and scaling Claude.

  • Own the story for how enterprises run Claude. Lead positioning and launches across security and observability, workspace management, and the controls for managing deployments, working with Product to turn new capabilities into clear reasons to adopt and expand.

  • Give sellers the conviction to close. Build and maintain the sales enablement assets (pitch decks, battle cards, objection handling) that help GTM answer security, deployment, and pricing questions with confidence.

  • Make sure the message reaches the right person, in their language. Minimum qualifications

  • Have owned positioning and messaging for an established enterprise software product, with decision makers and IT, security, or admin teams as a core audience

  • Have worked on enterprise pricing and packaging, including how plans are presented, how changes are communicated, and how the value story holds up with buyers

  • Have strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to make technical topics clear and adapt tone and complexity across formats like pitch decks, web copy, battlecards, and admin communications

  • Are comfortable operating autonomously as an IC, writing and shipping assets directly rather than through a team

  • Demonstrate systems thinking, and the ability to move fast and with conviction in an always-evolving environment

  • Are well-versed in using AI, especially Claude, to inform and automate product marketing work, and have built systems that update PMM foundations and share them with the teams who depend on them

  • Have experience marketing AI or productivity software to enterprise decision makers and IT, security, or admin audiences

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience marketing to customers in regulated industries (e.g., financial services, healthcare)

Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York office at least 2 days a week. We encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

$255,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. title: Director of Structured Finance
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:

  • New York, NY
  • San Francisco, CA
  • Austin, TX

About the team

The Finance team is a critical pillar of Cloudflare’s success, translating strategy into financial outcomes. Structured Finance is responsible for making sure Cloudflare has the right capital, on the right terms, to keep building one of the world’s largest networks.

About the role

Cloudflare is looking for a Director of Structured Finance to lead the structuring and execution of financings that support our global network and infrastructure strategy. Our infrastructure spans hundreds of cities worldwide, and as we continue to scale — including the servers, GPUs, and data center capacity that power our network, Workers AI, and our Developer Platform — how we finance that build-out is a strategic lever for the business.

You will own financing workstreams end-to-end: structuring, counterparty engagement, term negotiation, documentation, and close. You will partner closely with our Infrastructure, Hardware Sourcing, Treasury, Legal, Accounting, Tax, and FP&A teams to turn infrastructure plans into investable, well-priced transactions. The role will also extend to broader capital markets and capital structure work as the company grows.

This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role on a lean team. It combines hands-on transaction execution with financial analysis, relationship building with the financing community, and strategic decision support for senior leadership and the Board. We hold a very high bar on rigor and judgment, and we are AI-native in how we work.

What you’ll do

Infrastructure and asset financing

  • Own financing workstreams end-to-end for Cloudflare’s network and data center infrastructure — including equipment and hardware financing, leasing, vendor financing, and other structured solutions — from structuring and counterparty engagement through term negotiation, documentation, and close.
  • Translate infrastructure requirements and capex plans into clear, investable frameworks and materials for lenders, lessors, and other financing counterparties.
  • Represent Cloudflare independently in negotiations with external counterparties, exercising sound judgment on risk allocation, collateral, covenants, and commercial terms.
  • Evaluate lease vs. buy vs. finance trade-offs and recommend the structures that best balance cost of capital, flexibility, and risk.
  • Build repeatable internal frameworks, playbooks, and processes for evaluating, approving, and executing financing transactions.

Capital markets and capital structure

  • Collaborate with Cloudflare’s Treasury team on the company’s broader capital markets strategy, including debt, convertible, and other structured transactions, and contribute analysis on capital structure, liquidity, and cost of capital.
  • Develop and maintain a credible network of financing counterparties — banks, private credit funds, private equity, lessors, infrastructure investors, and OEM/vendor finance teams.
  • Monitor market conditions, pricing, and emerging financing structures, and bring new ideas to leadership.

Modeling, analysis, and decision support

  • Build and maintain rigorous financial models supporting transaction structuring, pricing, returns, and capital allocation decisions.
  • Prepare analysis and materials that distill complex financing decisions into clear recommendations for the CFO, senior leadership, and the Board.
  • Partner with Accounting, Tax, and Legal on accounting treatment (e.g., lease classification), tax implications, disclosure, and documentation.

Cross-functional partnership and execution

  • Partner with Infrastructure, Sourcing, Treasury, Legal, and leadership teams to keep transaction terms aligned with network build-out plans and broader company priorities.
  • Own post-close management of financing arrangements, including covenant compliance, reporting obligations, and ongoing counterparty relationships.
  • Use AI-native tooling and automation to scale the function — models, trackers, and workflows that let a small team operate with speed and accuracy.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

  • 10+ years of experience across structured or project finance, infrastructure investing, private credit, equipment leasing, private equity, investment banking, and/or corporate capital markets — ideally including time in-house at a high-growth technology or infrastructure company.
  • A track record of leading complex financing transactions through to close, including direct negotiation and documentation with external counterparties.
  • The ability to run a financing workstream independently, without close supervision, and to represent the company credibly with senior external counterparties.
  • Deep structuring expertise — e.g., equipment finance, leasing and sale-leaseback, asset-backed and project finance, vendor financing, and debt or convertible capital markets — plus creativity in designing new structures to meet company goals.
  • Advanced financial modeling, credit analysis, and transaction documentation skills, including familiarity with credit agreements, master lease agreements, and related legal documentation.
  • Working knowledge of the accounting and tax implications of financing structures, and comfort partnering with Accounting, Tax, and Legal to get them right.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex structures legible to non-specialist leadership and to influence diverse stakeholders.
  • Comfort with ambiguity — the ability to drive clarity, manage competing priorities, and execute at a high bar in a fast-moving environment.
  • High-trust collaboration — the ability to build credibility quickly with senior internal stakeholders (CFO, Treasury, Legal, Accounting, Infrastructure) and external counterparties.
  • AI-native curiosity and skill — fluency with modern AI tooling and a track record of using it to amplify your impact.
  • Sound judgment with confidential information, including an understanding of the discretion required at a public company.
  • Sector background in data centers, digital infrastructure, telecom, cloud, or AI compute preferred; existing relationships with lenders, lessors, and infrastructure investors a plus.
  • MBA, CFA, or similar a plus, but not required.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

  • For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $206,000 - $284,000
  • For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $196,000 - $270,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

  • Medical/Rx Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Commuter Spending Accounts
  • Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
  • On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
  • Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

  • Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

  • Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
  • Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.

This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.

  • Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.
  • Lead the development of agentic payment systems leveraging emerging open standards (x402, Web Bot Auth, ACP, UCP) to enable low-latency, machine-to-machine micropayments.
  • Lead the engineering behind usage metering, pricing definition engines, outcome verification, and revenue attribution models tailored for agentic workflows.
  • Build capabilities that give businesses granular visibility and control over their agent-generated revenue streams.
  • Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.
  • Bridge mainstream and decentralized tech, interfacing with blockchain teams while keeping execution focused on mainstream, high-throughput web and fiat commerce rails.
  • Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.
  • Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, cryptographic security, and long-term reliability.
  • Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.

We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:

  • You have led and developed a high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.

  • You are comfortable managing a team working across several related technical areas (like digital wallets, payment protocols, and web authorization) and can create clarity without requiring every problem to fit neatly into a single box.
  • You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system handles monetary transactions or machine authorization.
  • You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.
  • You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.

  • Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, low-latency transaction processing, API design, web security, or adjacent areas.
  • Experience building or operating products involving traditional payment rails, digital wallets, or open authorization/authentication standards (e.g., OAuth, WebAuthn, Web Bot Auth).
  • Experience operating systems where correctness, reliability, and security matter as much as feature delivery.
  • A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.
  • Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.
  • Strong written and verbal communication.

You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions, ask the right questions when something is going wrong, and step into a technical problem when the situation calls for it.

This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.

What you'll do

  • Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across AI-powered search, Internet data insights, and customer-facing products.
  • Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.
  • Lead the development of search and retrieval capabilities that help people and AI agents find relevant, trustworthy, and current content.

  • Experience working with large-scale telemetry or Internet-scale datasets.
  • Experience turning complex underlying systems or data into useful products for a broad audience.

Examples include managing unwanted scraping, controlling access for bots and AI agents, and identifying fraud and abuse while minimizing friction for legitimate users. Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment, using Cloudflare's global network signals, threat intelligence, and machine learning. We turn those signals into analytics and controls that customers can understand, trust, and act on. The role means balancing competing demands every day: build deadlines against build quality, dependence on partners against high standards, and fast incident response against careful compliance. You need to keep both sides of each in view.

This role covers the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. It works closely with network engineering and server provisioning teams but does not own them.

Team Leadership

  • Hire, develop and manage Data Center Engineers based on-site at data centers across the US. Set clear expectations, career paths and a culture of ownership across a team spread over many sites.

  • Build and take part in a 24x7 on-call rotation with your team. Define coverage models, handover protocols and incident SLAs that hold up as the footprint grows.

  • Serve as the escalation point for on-site incidents. Coordinate engineers, colocation providers and vendors to restore service quickly, and lead root-cause analysis after major incidents so the same problem doesn't happen again.

Site Delivery

  • Own build timelines from site readiness through hardware delivery, rack-and-stack, cabling, validation and handoff to production.

  • Run greenfield builds as multi-workstream programs. Coordinate third-party integrators, contractors and colocation providers to hit dates without cutting corners.

  • Be on-site during key build phases to oversee vendor work, verify quality and make sure sites are production-ready.

Production Operations

  • Be accountable for availability targets for production hardware at your sites. Run break/fix, repairs, RMAs and spares strategy so that availability is measured, reported and improving.

  • Manage colocation providers and vendors day to day: escalations, remote-hands quality, power and cooling issues, and performance against contractual commitments.

Documentation and DCIM

  • Make sure every site is fully documented in DCIM from day one. That covers rack elevations, power and cabling, asset location, and lifecycle status, all recorded as hardware arrives rather than filled in later.

  • Treat infrastructure records as a source of truth that both operations and dependent teams rely on, giving them accurate, current visibility into where hardware is and what state it's in.

  • Partner with tooling teams to bring DCIM online at new sites, and define documentation standards that hold up as the footprint grows.

Decommissioning and Hardware Lifecycle

  • Own on-site decommissioning end to end: unracking, physical collections, serial number verification, chain of custody, and handoff for secure destruction.

  • Partner with vendor management on IT asset disposition (ITAD) vendors. Make sure destruction certificates and compliance evidence are filed and audit-ready.

Security and Compliance

  • Make sure your sites and team meet Cloudflare's physical security, access control, chain-of-custody and compliance obligations.

  • Follow established physical access procedures, and work with security and compliance teams to develop new ones where these sites need them.

  • Support audits with accurate, timely evidence. Treat audit readiness as a continuous standard, not something you prepare for once per audit cycle.

Automation and Operational Efficiency

  • Find manual, repetitive work in build, break/fix, decommissioning and evidence collection. Influence tooling and automation teams to remove it.

  • Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted workflows for incident triage, root-cause analysis, documentation and compliance evidence generation.

  • Scale the operation through tooling, not just headcount.

Business Reporting

  • Own weekly business reviews and monthly and quarterly reporting on availability, build progress, incidents and operational health to the Director and peer leaders.

  • Partner with network, systems, hardware, supply chain and infrastructure engineering teams to make sure physical operations support what runs on top of them.

Who You Are

A builder who stays to operate. You've stood up sites and teams, and you take ownership of what happens after go-live. Delivering a build is where your job starts. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.

A leader of distributed teams. You've hired and built trust with on-site engineers spread across many locations, most of whom you won't see day to day. You know how to create accountability, consistent standards and a shared culture across sites, both remotely and in person.

Firm with partners. You hold colocation providers and vendors to high standards without becoming adversarial. You know the contract, you track performance, and you escalate when it's warranted.

Compliance-minded without being a compliance specialist. You understand why access controls and decommissioning chain of custody are audit controls. You treat compliance as part of doing the work well, not as overhead.

Automation-first. When something hurts, your first instinct is to fix the process or the tooling, not add people. You can turn an operational pain point into requirements engineering teams can act on.

Required Experience

  • 6+ years in data center operations, including 3+ years directly managing on-site technical teams. At least part of that time should be leading geographically distributed teams.

  • A track record of operating multi-site data center fleets at hyperscale or large-cloud scale.

  • Hands-on experience with IT hardware, including servers, network devices, optics and cabling, not only facilities infrastructure.

  • Enough hands-on depth to coach engineers on technical work and to judge the quality of vendor and contractor work.

  • Experience owning sites across the full lifecycle: delivering greenfield data center or cage builds through third-party vendors, running them in steady state, and decommissioning hardware.

  • Experience managing providers in Tier III+ colocation facilities and holding them accountable to commitments.

  • Experience managing 24x7 on-call operations and incident escalation.

  • Strong Layer 1 and Layer 2 fundamentals: structured cabling, fiber and optics, patching standards, switching basics, and troubleshooting physical connectivity for network and server hardware.

  • Solid knowledge of data center power and cooling, rack design, high-density deployments and hardware lifecycle management.

  • Strong understanding of DCIM and asset management systems. You should have a track record of keeping documentation accurate from day one, including rack, power, cabling and asset records maintained from hardware arrival through decommissioning.

  • Working knowledge of the security and compliance frameworks common in enterprise-grade data centers. You should understand them well enough to run operations under them; auditor-level expertise isn't required.

  • Strong program management skills across multiple vendors, sites and time-bound workstreams.

  • A track record of reducing toil through tooling or process redesign.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including regular business reviews and status, risk and availability reporting to leadership.

  • Ability to travel regularly to data center sites. Expect more frequent travel during site builds, shifting to periodic visits as sites reach steady state.

  • Experience standing up a new data center operations function or region from zero.

  • Background at a hyperscaler, cloud provider, major CDN or similarly fast-scaling infrastructure company.

  • Background in hardware diagnostics, burn-in or automated build validation.

Within Developer GTM, the Revenue Engineering team exists to build and evolve GTM infrastructure to support Cloudflare’s transition into a major cloud provider and drive Cloudflare’s AI transformation.   • Prototype & Deliver High-Impact Applications: Directly build and prototype novel GTM applications (Signals, Customer Health, Cost Explorer), evolve core pipelines (Salesforce enrichment, customer contact ingestion, real-time consumption billing visibility), and implement data infrastructure migrations.
