We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: London or Austin or SF or NYC

About the Department

Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.

About the Team

We build the infrastructure that makes the web Payable, powering high-volume, low-value machine-to-machine transactions using blockchain technologies and decentralized protocols. Here at Cloudflare, stablecoin payments are a core initiative developing blockchain-based settlement systems, programmable agent wallets, and cryptographic primitives to make the web payable at machine scale. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We build tools that leverage Web3 wallets and decentralized rails to give domain owners and agents secure, scalable settlement options.

Building these capabilities requires solving problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols. We bridge mainstream commerce rails with decentralized smart contract environments, enabling micropayments at Internet scale to keep the web payable.

We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.

About the role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead the engineering team across our stablecoin initiatives.

You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that power decentralized agent transactions, such as Cloudflare’s stablecoin wallets and emerging micropayment rails that make web resources payable. You will partner closely with Product Management, cryptography experts, and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible in distributed systems, smart contracts, and cryptographic protocols. You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions around blockchains (including transactions, RPCs, and execution + consensus clients) and step in when necessary.

At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.

This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.

What you'll do

  • Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across blockchain architecture, stablecoin wallets, and cryptographic payment channels to ensure the web remains payable for autonomous agents.
  • Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.
  • Lead the development of a high-throughput blockchain leveraging cryptocurrency protocols and standards to enable ultra-low-latency micropayments.
  • Lead the engineering behind usage metering, pricing definition engines, outcome verification, and revenue attribution models tailored for agentic workflows.
  • Build capabilities that give businesses granular visibility and control over their agent-generated revenue streams.
  • Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.
  • Interface directly with blockchain, wallet, and cryptography teams while scaling decentralized transaction pipelines on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects.
  • Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.
  • Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, cryptographic security, and long-term reliability.
  • Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.

Responsibilities

We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:

  • You have led and developed a high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.
  • You are technically credible with experienced blockchain and systems engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in smart contract security or decentralized architecture, and evaluate cryptographic protocols.
  • You are comfortable managing a team working across specialized crypto topics (like decentralized settlement, programmable wallets, and key management systems).
  • You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system handles monetary transactions or machine authorization.
  • You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.
  • You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Strong technical grounding in blockchain architecture, smart contract environments, and cryptographic key management. Past experience building L1 or L2 blockchains is a plus.
  • Experience building or operating cryptocurrency infrastructure, digital wallet providers, or decentralized settlement protocols. Past experience working on consumer or enterprise cryptocurrency wallets is a plus.
  • Experience operating systems where correctness, reliability, and security matter as much as feature delivery.
  • A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.
  • Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.
  • Strong written and verbal communication.

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with decentralized payment protocols or blockchain frameworks (e.g., Bitcoin Lightning, Ethereum rollups).
  • Experience building hybrid fiat/crypto payment infrastructure, such as onramp/offramp providers or apps where cryptocurrencies are invisible to users.
  • Familiarity with Cloudflare’s developer platform (Workers, Durable Objects, KV) or edge computing architectures.
  • Experience turning complex underlying systems into useful payment or commerce products for a broad audience.
  • Experience with usage-based billing, metering engines, attribution systems, or complex commercial pricing models.
  • Previous experience working in payments or on payments technology (fiat or crypto)

  • For NYC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $190,000 - $275,000

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: London, UK, Lisbon, Portugal

About the Team

Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organisations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won't find someone at Cloudflare that isn't committed to your success - with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development.

As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats.

This position has working hours Monday to Friday 09:00 a.m. to 06:00 p.m. Occasionally, we support our customers during the weekends for specific changes that need to be done outside of their business hours. Travel is expected at 30%.

About the role:

The Services Sales Consultant (SSC) is a dynamic pre-sales professional, passionate about technology evangelism and developing custom services solutions to drive business growth. This role focuses on architecting and sizing the essential service components that enable the Cloudflare platform. The SSC excels at presenting how the successful integration of technology and services translates into tangible business value for customers.

A core objective of the SSC is to grow the Cloudflare professional services business. This involves direct engagement with customers to define the specific service requirements needed to maximize the value of their technology investment and achieve their desired technical and business outcomes.

The SSC works in a fast-paced environment and is instrumental in enabling Cloudflare customers to securely achieve their goals. This is accomplished by creating and proposing a comprehensive services wrapper tailored to meet each customer's unique needs.

The SSC maintains close working relationships across the organisation, partnering directly with the Services Sales team, Core and Specialist Sales, as well as establishing strong connections with Delivery teams, Global Delivery Practices, and other subject matter experts within Cloudflare Professional Services.

The successful candidate will recommend the appropriate blend of Cloudflare services to assist customers in planning and executing large-scale transformations, ensuring they leverage maximum value from the portfolio.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Services Sales to clearly define Cloudflare's differentiated approach to Go-to-Market (GTM) services. Showcase our delivery capabilities, IP, and expertise through compelling success stories that demonstrate how we solve customer needs.
  • Gathering, understanding and defining customer specific requirements and expectations for value based outcomes in workshop based scenarios.
  • Collaborating with Services Sales, Delivery and Global Practices to construct solution proposals and Statements of Work to satisfy customer specific scope requirements and outcome based services.
  • Collaborating with Services Sales to drive business growth for Cloudflare Services in your aligned territory.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of proven experience in technical consulting, pre-sales, or service delivery within an IT or Cybersecurity services organization.
  • Self–motivated and detail–oriented.
  • Strong written, verbal and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated experience in discovery/scope definition workshops with cross–functional internal and customer resources to prepare current state/future state roadmaps and services proposals.
  • Experience of working across multiple regions.
  • Cybersecurity experience preferred.
  • Experience and familiarity with using SFDC or similar CRM tools.
  • Cloudflare Platform experience will be an extra asset.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Available Locations: Austin, TX

About the Role

Cloudflare’s mission is to help build a better Internet - one that is more secure, faster, and more reliable for every organization on the planet. The Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Zero Trust market represents one of the most transformative growth opportunities in enterprise technology, reshaping how businesses connect, protect, and empower their global workforce.

To lead this next chapter, Cloudflare has created the Cloudflare One (CF1) Speedboat - a dedicated, cross-functional organization designed to operate with the focus, agility, and autonomy of a startup, backed by the global scale and infrastructure of Cloudflare.

We are seeking a visionary, entrepreneurial executive to serve as the Vice President, CF1 GTM. In this role, you will own and scale a high-growth global business, define the GTM strategy, and build a multi-billion-dollar business in one of the most dynamic markets of the decade. This is an extraordinary opportunity to lead a “company within a company,” shaping the future of how enterprises secure and connect to the Internet.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and Scale the Business: Act as the general manager of Cloudflare One business unit, with full accountability for global GTM strategy, execution, and P&L performance.
  • Define the Market Strategy: Craft and execute a bold, differentiated strategy to establish Cloudflare as the world’s leading SASE and Zero Trust platform. Align product innovation, ecosystem partnerships, and field execution behind a unified vision.
  • Build a World-Class Leadership Team: Recruit, develop, and lead a global organization across sales, solution engineering, success, operations, and GTM strategy - fostering a culture of speed, accountability, and innovation.
  • Drive Operational Excellence: Establish and manage a high-velocity operating cadence, including forecasting, pipeline management, QBRs, and executive-level reporting grounded in data-driven insights.
  • Champion the Partner-First Motion: Drive growth through deep collaboration with Cloudflare’s partner ecosystem - enabling global systems integrators, MSPs, and channel partners to scale Cloudflare One’s reach and impact.
  • Be the Voice of the Field: Serve as the bridge between the market and the business. Translate customer and partner feedback into actionable insights for Product and Engineering to accelerate innovation and adoption.
  • Lead the AI Security Motion: Own Cloudflare's GTM for AI-native enterprises - from Digital Native AI companies building on Cloudflare infrastructure to large enterprises securing AI workloads. Drive adoption of AI Gateway, Zero Trust for AI model access, and DLP for prompt-level data protection as the entry motion into this segment.
  • Evangelize the Vision: Represent Cloudflare One as an executive spokesperson with customers, partners, industry analysts, and at major events. Position Cloudflare as the thought leader shaping the future of Zero Trust and network security..

Qualifications & Experience

  • Enterprise Builder: 15+ years leading large-scale enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity businesses, ideally with prior GM or P&L ownership experience.
  • Strategic Visionary: Deep understanding of cybersecurity, networking, and cloud ecosystems - including SASE, Zero Trust, SD-WAN, and network security.
  • Partner-First Leader: Proven record of building and scaling partner-led GTM models and ecosystem-driven growth strategies.
  • Competitive Depth: Track record of winning against entrenched security incumbents in enterprise accounts, with specific fluency in the SASE competitive landscape.
  • AI Market Fluency: Working understanding of how enterprises are deploying AI infrastructure and the security, connectivity, and observability requirements that it creates.
  • Operational Excellence: Demonstrated ability to design and execute rigorous operating frameworks that drive sustained, measurable growth.
  • Inspirational Leadership: Known for building high-performance global teams and cultivating cultures of excellence, collaboration, and inclusion.
  • Executive Presence: Exceptional communication and storytelling skills; comfortable engaging with customers, analysts, boards, and global audiences.

Why This Role

This is not a traditional GTM leadership role - it’s an opportunity to scale a generational business inside one of the world’s most innovative technology companies. The Vice President, CF1 GTM will define how enterprises secure, connect, and operate in the modern Internet era - and in doing so, shape the next chapter of Cloudflare’s growth story.

About the role

Cloudflare is looking for a highly experienced and visionary new leader of its Global Trust and Safety team. In pursuit of its goal to “help build a better Internet,” Cloudflare operates one of the world’s largest and most important cloud networks. Maintaining the high level of trust between the Company and our customers, partners, and the larger Cloudflare community is critical. Our Trust and Safety team operates in a dynamic environment to implement policies that further this trust, responding to legal requests for information about our customers and use of our network, assisting Cloudflare employees implementing security and compliance programs, and supporting our customers, their users, and complaining parties to address claims of abuse.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with and are willing to roll up their sleeves to fix them. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. What you'll do

In this role, you will lead Cloudflare’s team of investigators and engineers who process requests for information and abuse reports through a system of automated systems and manual escalation protocols. You will be expected to provide vision for the team, developing new ways to build trust in Cloudflare’s network, consistent with Cloudflare’s principles. You will create and maintain clear policies, identify appropriate areas and mechanisms for automation, and ensure consistent and fair application of Cloudflare’s standards. You will be responsible for identifying and recruiting top talent to your team and engaging with leaders across the organization, including the Legal, Policy, Security, Communications, Support, Product and Engineering teams. You will also represent the company externally with industry peers and government officials, and help identify potential trust and safety related partners and engagements.

Based on the variety of products offered by Cloudflare and the complexity of global legal standards covering requests for information and abuse, the right candidate will have technical expertise, be able to create policies and protocols that account for this complexity, effectively manage a global team responsible for implementing those changing policies, and develop creative solutions that take advantage of Cloudflare’s tools to improve trust and safety functions across the company. You will be expected to solve hard problems under pressure, often with senior executives and internal experts, and clearly communicate your vision to stakeholders across the company.

Responsibilities:

  • Help design and build a trust and safety function for a highly technical company that is designed for the age of AI.
  • Build, develop, and manage a world-class globally-distributed team that operates 24/7/365.
  • Create and maintain processes and policies for handling legal requests and abuse complaints.
  • Ensure consistent, timely, efficient, and fair application of those policies across a variety of circumstances and locations, incorporating AI-powered automation and processing,
  • Liaise with senior company leaders, attorneys, engineers, and security staff inside Cloudflare to address circumstances that arise with regard to operation of the Trust & Safety team.
  • Work with engineers to create and improve automated tools to drive improvements and increase efficiencies.
  • Partner with the Policy, Legal, and Product teams to develop and implement policies and guidelines that can be enforced in a scalable fashion.
  • Deal with sensitive content and emotionally charged escalations with tact and a calm demeanor.
  • Take responsibility for online fraud and safety concerns, including but not limited to account security, safety concerns and user trust.

  • Maintain and build upon Cloudflare’s transparency reporting process by identifying new areas of interest and information that we should be sharing with the public to maintain trust.

  • 8+ years experience managing a large team effectively with a strong desire to help others learn and grow.
  • Experience working with law enforcement and legal requests for customer information.
  • Deep technical experience understanding how the Internet works.
  • Understanding of the Internet ecosystem and the roles and functions of the various types of online service providers.
  • Experience in assessing, analyzing, and resolving complex and sensitive issues, often under considerable time pressure. You must have demonstrated the ability to thrive in crisis management.
  • Experience with analytics and experience solving problems using data and providing practical business insights.
  • Experience working closely with c-suite level executives.
  • Significant awareness of existing and emerging approaches to law enforcement access and intermediary liability to be able to engage on such issues at a very high level.
  • A global network of contacts --you can reach the right people quickly to help solve problems that you can’t solve directly.

  • Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Excellent collaboration and consensus-building skills.
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask; ability to adapt to a fast-moving environment.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

title: Enterprise Demand Generation Marketing Manager
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

This role is based in our San Francisco office and is also open to remote candidates in the US.

We're hiring an Enterprise Demand Generation Marketing Manager to build and run the programs that fill our pipeline. You'll own campaigns across paid media, webinars, account-based marketing, and social, from strategy through launch and optimization.

This is a builder role. You'll stand up programs that don't exist yet, ship them quickly, and scale what works. You'll partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content, Design and RevOps to turn target accounts into qualified pipeline.

What you'll do

  • Plan, launch and optimize paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, Meta and content syndication channels, owning budget pacing, testing and reporting on CAC, pipeline and ROI

  • Run the webinar program end to end: pick topics and speakers, drive promotion and production, and manage follow-up through to pipeline conversion

  • Partner with Sales to define target account lists and build tiered account-based marketing plays (1:1, 1:few, 1:many), orchestrating multi-channel touches that drive engagement and meetings

  • Use paid and organic social to reach buyers, amplify campaigns and generate demand, working closely with Content and Creative

  • Define KPIs for each program and collaborate with RevOps on dashboards that show what's contributing to pipeline and revenue

  • Stand up new channels and programs, test quickly, cut what isn't working and scale what is

  • Align daily with Sales, SDRs, Product Marketing, Content, Design and RevOps on targets, messaging and handoffs

What you'll need

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience running paid campaigns on LinkedIn, Google or Meta, with a track record of hitting pipeline targets

  • Experience building and scaling a webinar program that converts attendees into pipeline

  • Experience running account-based marketing in close partnership with Sales, including account selection, orchestration and measurement

  • A track record of using paid and organic social as a demand channel

  • Strong analytical skills, comfortable with attribution, funnel metrics and turning data into decisions

  • Working knowledge of marketing automation and CRM tools (for example, HubSpot or Marketo, and Salesforce)

  • Clear, concise communication skills and the ability to align multiple teams around a plan

  • Experience marketing to large, complex organizations with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders

  • Strong project management instincts; you can run several overlapping campaigns at once and keep timelines, owners and dependencies organized

  • A builder's mindset: you'd rather create programs, processes and playbooks from scratch than inherit a finished machine

  • A collaborative approach; you work across teams every day, share credit, take feedback well, and treat Sales as a partner

  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your daily workflow, for drafting copy, building audience lists and analyzing campaign results

Nice to have:

  • Experience marketing to creative, media or enterprise audiences

  • Experience on an early-stage or scaling marketing team

  • Familiarity with AI tools that speed up campaign production and analysis

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't check every box.

As Engineering Manager, Architecture Engineering: Async, you'll lead a distributed group of Site Reliability Engineers and Backend Engineers. You'll support their development and balance production reliability with platform projects, including zero-downtime Redis upgrades, support for single-tenant and cell-based deployments, and the move from queue-based job orchestration to a durable workflow engine.

What you'll do

  • Lead, hire, and grow a team of site reliability engineers and backend engineers, supporting career development, promotions, and onboarding.
  • Own reliability for the job processing and caching platforms, including service-level objectives, error budgets, alerting, and weekly operational reviews.
  • Manage capacity planning, support escalations, and incident follow-ups, balancing operational work with roadmap projects and rescoping work when deadlines can't be met.
  • Run the team's part of GitLab.com's first-tier on-call rotation, including shift coverage, onboarding, and handovers, and serve as incident commander for high-severity incidents.
  • Drive zero-downtime Redis version upgrades and automate operating system patching and reboots.
  • Adapt job processing to run in single-tenant and cell-based deployments.
  • Own the migration from queue-based job orchestration to a durable workflow engine, defining the first use cases, a measurable migration path, and the roadmap.
  • Own quarterly planning and the team roadmap, and clarify shared operational responsibilities with partner teams, including Git storage.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you'll bring

  • Experience managing an engineering team delivering high-performance services at scale, ideally site reliability engineers or infrastructure engineers running production software as a service systems.
  • Technical depth in background job processing and caching technologies such as Redis and Sidekiq, sufficient to guide decisions about upgrades, capacity, and failure modes.
  • Experience managing reliability against service-level objectives, including defining service-level indicators, setting up burn-rate alerting, and planning capacity.
  • Experience running a 24/7 on-call rotation and coordinating high-severity incidents.
  • A track record of balancing operational work and incident follow-ups with roadmap projects, and pushing back on scope when deadlines can't be met.

The Async team runs GitLab.com's background processing layer, from the Sidekiq infrastructure to the shared code that enqueues jobs. We staff GitLab.com's first-tier production on-call rotation in 8-hour shifts across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific, triaging every paging alert and bringing in the right team when needed.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Senior Engineering Manager , Twilio’s Segment team.

About the job

As a Senior Engineering Manager on the Twilio Segment Data platform/ pipelines team, you’ll build and scale systems that process several hundred thousands of data points per second. You will lead the development of high-scale ingestion and data processing systems You'll guide the team in designing, operating and maintaining complex distributed systems, ensuring reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency while querying petabytes of data for our customer data platform (CDP).

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own and deliver robust, high-scale routing experiences for Data platforms & pipelines for Twilio Segment.
  • Champion team growth and success, prioritizing mentorship and individual development.
  • Architect and operate always-available, complex distributed systems in cloud environments.
  • Guide technical decisions, articulating trade-offs between cost, performance, and reliability.
  • Advocate for agile processes, continuous integration, and robust automation.
  • Translate complex technical strategies into actionable plans for diverse stakeholders, including Product Managers and Architects.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 14+ years of engineering experience with a 5+ year proven track record managing software teams.

title: Director of Technology Partnerships
description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Director of Technology Partnerships to lead the teams responsible for growing Supabase through technology integrations and our marketplace ecosystem.

You’ll bring together two complementary motions: partnerships that embed Supabase into the products developers already use, and a marketplace that helps developers discover and connect complementary technologies to their Supabase projects. Your job is to turn both into durable sources of revenue, adoption, and customer value.

Reporting to the Head of Partnerships, you’ll lead and develop the Integrations and Marketplace teams, set their commercial strategy, and work hands-on with our most important partners. A central part of the role is working closely with AI labs to build strategic relationships, develop integrations, and bring joint opportunities to market. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Finance to take integrations from idea to launch—and grow their impact long after launch.

This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, where you’ll build relationships with leading AI, developer tools, and infrastructure companies. Supabase is remote-first, and you’ll work across a globally distributed team.

Responsibilities

Lead the team and strategy

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Integrations and Marketplace partnerships teams, including team leads and partner managers.

  • Set a clear strategy for where Supabase invests across strategic technology partnerships, marketplace categories, and emerging ecosystem opportunities.

  • Define team objectives, partner coverage, investment priorities, and operating cadence. Make thoughtful tradeoffs between high-touch strategic partnerships and scalable programs.

  • Build a culture of ownership, commercial discipline, and strong cross-functional execution.

Grow revenue through technology partnerships

  • Drive revenue from technology integrations through partner-driven customer acquisition, product consumption, expansion, retention, co-sell opportunities, and commercial arrangements.

  • Own the commercial performance of the technology partnerships and marketplace portfolio, including forecasting and reporting on progress, risks, and return on investment.

  • Build and deepen relationships with AI labs, working closely with their product, engineering, business development, and executive teams to identify and execute high-impact partnership opportunities.

  • Develop executive relationships with strategic partners across developer tools, cloud, and adjacent infrastructure.

  • Lead or support negotiations for complex partnerships, including integration, referral, revenue-sharing, and joint go-to-market agreements.

  • Help partner managers build joint business plans that connect partner priorities to measurable outcomes for Supabase and its customers.

Lead the marketplace team

  • Lead and develop the Marketplace team, setting its commercial and partner strategy and holding the team accountable for outcomes.

  • Guide the team in identifying the capabilities developers need, recruiting the right partners, and helping those partners launch and grow.

  • Set priorities and allocate resources across strategic, high-touch partners and scalable paths for emerging and self-serve partners.

  • Ensure the team works effectively with Product and Engineering on integration quality, partner onboarding, discovery, activation, and the developer experience across product surfaces.

  • Enable the team to work with Marketing and Sales to launch integrations, enable teams, and drive ongoing adoption—not just announcements.

Operate with rigor

  • Establish clear measures for partner-sourced and influenced pipeline, integration adoption, revenue, consumption, retention, and marketplace performance.

  • Work with Finance, Data, and Partner Operations to improve attribution, reporting, forecasting, and partner revenue processes.

  • Represent the voice of partners and customers in product and go-to-market planning, while aligning stakeholders around shared priorities.

  • Identify risks early, remove blockers, and communicate decisions and outcomes clearly to leadership.

Requirements

  • Have significant experience in technology partnerships, business development, or ecosystem leadership at a developer tools, cloud, infrastructure, or SaaS company.

  • Have led and developed partner-facing teams, including managers or senior individual contributors, and can balance strategic direction with hands-on execution.

  • Have a track record of building partnerships that produced measurable revenue, product adoption, or customer growth.

  • Have negotiated complex commercial agreements and understand partnership economics, including revenue share, referrals, and consumption-based models.

  • Have worked closely with Product and Engineering to ship and grow technical integrations. You can engage credibly with technical teams, including those at AI labs, even if you aren’t the person writing the code.

  • Know how to build relationships with executives while earning the trust of product, engineering, and go-to-market teams.

  • Use data to prioritize opportunities, assess partner performance, and make decisions when attribution is imperfect.

  • Are comfortable building in an evolving environment, communicating in writing, and working asynchronously across time zones.

It’s a plus if you have

  • Built or scaled a developer marketplace, integration ecosystem, or partner platform.

  • Worked with AI LLMs, AI app builders, databases, open-source products, or developer infrastructure.

  • A background in software development, with an understanding of how developers build and integrate products.

  • Experience growing both a small number of strategic partnerships and a broader, scalable partner program.

  • A strong network in the San Francisco Bay Area technology ecosystem.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Head of Enablement Experience & Innovation
region: San Francisco, CA / New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's sales organization is growing quickly across segments, industries, and geographies, and enablement needs to be reinvented to keep up. We are looking for a Head of Enablement Experience & Innovation to build the next generation of enablement with a Claude-first approach: hyper-personalized for each seller, delivered in the flow of work, and measured by what it changes.

Most sales enablement still runs on courses, content libraries, and one-size-fits-all programs. You will start instead from what Claude makes possible: understanding what sellers need, designing experiences around their role, tenure, and live deals, and bringing the right guidance into the tools where they already work. This is a rare chance to define what enablement looks like when it is built on the product we sell.

This is a leadership role for an innovator with deep expertise in using AI for enablement and a background in user experience design, product management, or workflow design. You have shipped experiences at scale and can show that people used them and performed better. You will start as an individual contributor, set direction, and build a team over time, staying close enough to the field to know when something is not working.

Key responsibilities:

  • Set the vision and roadmap for a Claude-first approach to enablement, deciding what to build, what to retire, and how enablement is designed and delivered

  • Use Claude to tailor learning to each seller's role, tenure, and live deals

  • Design workflows that bring guidance to sellers in the tools they already use, at the moment they need it

  • Lead the learning platform, enablement tools, playbooks, and content hub, using Claude to keep knowledge accurate, current, and easy to find

  • Run enablement like a product: lead discovery with sellers and sales leaders, work with engineering and design, and test on live deals before scaling

  • Track adoption and the impact on ramp time, win rate, and attainment, and act on what the data shows

  • Partner with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Product, Marketing, and the wider Sales Enablement team so that programs, systems, and workflows feel like one experience

  • Run fast experiments with new Claude capabilities, scale what works, and set clear standards for responsible AI use and data governance in enablement

Minimum qualifications:

  • Deep, hands-on expertise using AI to design and deliver enablement or learning at scale, such as personalized learning, AI coaching, or guidance in daily workflows

  • Background in user experience design, product management, or workflow design, applied to enablement, learning, or sales tools

  • Have led the design and launch of a product or learning experience at scale, and can show how adoption and results changed

  • Have worked directly with senior sales leaders and frontline managers to secure sponsorship for change, including holding a position constructively when they disagreed

  • Have tested and improved programs with sellers and sales leaders before scaling them

  • Have defined and tracked adoption and impact measures that go beyond completion and satisfaction scores

  • Have run programs across multiple geographies, segments, or roles

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience building and leading a team of senior enablement professionals, and comfort delivering hands-on until you have one

  • A clear, experience-based view of why learning programs often fail to change how sellers work

  • Prior experience in a sales or customer-facing role

  • Experience at an AI company or an enterprise technology company during a period of rapid sales team scaling

  • Hands-on experience building with Claude or similar AI tools to personalize learning or improve how people find knowledge

  • Clear written and spoken communication with executive audiences

  • Experience selecting and running learning platforms and enablement tools

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$310,000—$360,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with banks, asset managers, insurers, and private capital firms to deploy production-grade AI systems in high-stakes financial environments. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development, embedding deeply with customers to translate frontier model capabilities into reliable, auditable systems that create measurable business impact. title: Engineering Manager, Integrity and Attestation
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the team

The Integrity and Attestation team's remit is to prove what is running at Anthropic: what code it is, where it came from, and whether the machine underneath it is in a known-good state. We build the systems that cryptographically verify build artifacts, model weights, and machines, from hardware roots of trust through firmware and boot to the credentials a workload receives. We also secure the management plane of our servers. These controls protect our model weights and customer data across cloud providers and bare-metal AI data centers, including sites operated by partners.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead this team. Anthropic is bringing up new compute quickly, across new hardware platforms and new partners, and each one has to meet the same bar. In this role you will set the team's charter, practices, and priorities. You will partner with our infrastructure, data center, and hardware teams, as well as outside vendors, so that integrity is designed in rather than added later. The goal is simple to state: a machine gets secrets and workloads only after it proves it should, and a new site reaches that bar without slowing down compute.

About the role

  • Own the integrity roadmap: threat model from silicon and firmware up through the operating system and workloads, decide what to build, and deliver it
  • Be able to reason about the design and implementation of remote attestation, measured and verified boot, hardware roots of trust (TPM, SPDM), machine identity, and the reference values that define known-good
  • Make attestation the default path, so machines receive credentials and join clusters only after proving their firmware, system software, and security configuration, with no human in the loop
  • Build provenance for what we deploy: signed build artifacts and model weights, independent verification, and tamper-evident transparency logs
  • Lead the protection of sensitive data in use and at rest, including encryption and the chokepoints that control access to it
  • Secure the server management plane across every site: scoped and audited access to baseboard management controllers and management of per-device credentials
  • Make security repeatable as compute grows, so a new site or hardware platform inherits these controls in hours, not weeks
  • Join compute bring-up, data center, and hardware teams at design time
  • Define clear ownership with partner teams: when operations move to another team, your team keeps the security properties and can prove they still hold
  • Own the integrity evidence for our security goals and compliance: the invariants hold, and you can prove it
  • Hire, grow, and retain senior security software engineers; own their career development, and set the practices the team runs on as it scales

Who you are

  • Low ego, high empathy; has built diverse teams and has former reports who would vouch for them.
  • Experience managing infrastructure or security engineering teams, including hiring, developing, and managing senior and staff engineers
  • Has grown engineers into staff or lead roles, and experience with performance management
  • Created and maintained a high performing in hypergrowth environments. Kept a team intact and delivering through reorgs, charter changes, or leadership turnover
  • Experience owning a security or infrastructure domain end to end: setting multi-year strategy, delivering year-long cross-organizational work with little direction, and answering to executives for its risk and tradeoffs
  • An appreciation for distributed systems and properties beyond security, including reliability, efficiency, and maintainability
  • Scaled a team and its systems together through hypergrowth, where last quarter's architecture was already too small
  • Hands-on engineering in at least one of: platform security, secure boot and firmware, hardware roots of trust, confidential computing, or software supply chain integrity
  • Threat modeling and risk assessment for systems that span hardware and software, with strong security judgment and pragmatism
  • Comfortable leading through ambiguity with multiple partner teams and outside vendors, where you don't control the hardware or the schedule

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • At least 5+ years managing engineering teams and 8+ years hands-on in platform, infrastructure, or security engineering
  • Built or operated remote attestation, device identity, or fleet-wide boot integrity at production scale
  • Worked with BMCs, Redfish, GPU or accelerator attestation, or large-scale bare-metal provisioning
  • Experience with Nitro, SEV-SNP, TDX, or similar confidential computing platforms
  • Built signing, provenance, or transparency systems such as Sigstore, SLSA, or binary transparency
  • Designed key management or offline ceremonies for high-value secrets
  • Worked in high-assurance environments where controls had to be evidenced, not just deployed
  • Taken infrastructure from zero to one and then to maturity: built the first version where nothing existed, then run and hardened it into a system other teams depend on
  • Built or rebuilt a hiring loop and held the bar while adding headcount quickly
  • Pragmatic and steady: cares about unblocking research, product and compute as much as a clean architecture, and brings patience and judgment to opinionated senior engineers
  • Clear and persuasive communicator in writing and in person
  • Familiarity with AI security and safety concepts

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Robinhood is looking for a Director of Corporate Development to help accelerate our roadmap by identifying, vetting, and executing acquisitions, strategic investments, and other transactions. In this role, you will develop a deep understanding of Robinhood's strategic priorities and market landscape, and partner with GMs and senior leadership to identify high-potential opportunities across our existing and future product verticals and geographies. You will help build Robinhood's network of founders, investors, and bankers, and develop relationships that may lead to acquisitions or strategic investments.

You will work closely with deal sponsors and cross-functional leaders across Robinhood on all aspects of M&A, including business case construction, valuation analysis, deal structuring, negotiation, due diligence, execution, and post-close integration. What you bring

  • Track record of sourcing, leading, and closing complex technology acquisitions or strategic investments, ideally including in-house corporate development experience.
  • Exceptional analytical skills, including company valuation, financial modeling, and structured problem solving.

title: Head of ASEAN, Applied AI
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the founding leader of Applied AI Solutions Architecture in Singapore, you will drive the adoption of frontier AI by enabling the deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, and API) across ASEAN enterprises and digital-first organizations. You'll leverage your technical skills and consultative sales experience to drive positive AI transformation that addresses our customers' business needs, meets their technical requirements, and provides a high degree of reliability and safety.

You'll be responsible for building and leading the ASEAN Applied AI team from the ground up. Applied AI comprises Solutions Architects, Product Engineers, and Finetuning Engineers. You will establish processes and best practices for the region's technical pre-sales engagements based on your years of experience, help each team member achieve success, high productivity, and career growth, and represent Anthropic as a technical lead on some of its most important partnerships across ASEAN.

In collaboration with the Sales, Product, and Engineering teams globally and locally, you'll help enterprise partners across ASEAN incorporate leading-edge AI systems into their cutting-edge products and platforms. You will employ your excellent communication skills to explain and demonstrate complex solutions persuasively to technical and non-technical audiences alike. You will play a critical role in identifying opportunities to innovate and differentiate our AI systems, while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

  • Build and manage the foundational team of Applied AI professionals in ASEAN regions (Solutions Architects and Product Engineers) providing both technical guidance and career development
  • Set goals and reviews for your team, promoting growth and output
  • Work with a handful of highest-value enterprise customers across ASEAN on their overall AI adoption strategies, focusing on pre-sales technical excellence including use case scoping, technical champion building, and POC execution
  • Partner closely with your aligned GTM leadership to understand customer requirements & co-build GTM strategies to drive adoption for ASEAN enterprise customers
  • Contribute to thought leadership through conference presentations, webinars, and technical content creation within the ASEAN market
  • Own the technical portions of pre-sales engagements, ensuring your team provides compelling demos and validates enterprise customer ROI from Anthropic products
  • Drive collaboration from cross-functional teams to influence and unify stakeholders at all levels of the organization to drive business outcomes
  • Travel regularly to customer sites across ASEAN for executive-level sessions, technical workshops, and building relationships
  • Establish a shared vision for creating solutions that enable beneficial and safe AI in technology products
  • Lead the vision, strategy, and execution of innovative solutions that leverage our latest models' capabilities
  • Stay current with emerging AI/ML trends and competitive landscape in the ASEAN enterprise tech sector, including the region's highly regulated industries (financial services, government, resources)

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 15+ years of experience as a Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or similar pre-sales technical role
  • 5+ years of technical go-to-market management experience, specifically managing pre-sales teams
  • Experience working with ASEAN enterprise customers and understanding local business culture, procurement processes, and decision-making dynamics across ASEAN
  • Familiarity with the ASEAN regulatory landscape (e.g., Singapore Privacy Principles, APRA CPS 234, data sovereignty requirements) and how it impacts enterprise AI deployments
  • Experience with the unique technical requirements and technical procurement process of enterprise tech companies
  • Deep technical proficiency with enterprise AI deployments, API integrations, and production LLM use cases
  • Have an organizational mindset and enjoy building foundational teams in a relatively unstructured environment
  • Have excellent communication, collaboration, and coaching abilities
  • Are comfortable dealing with highly uncertain, ambiguous, and fast-moving environments typical of the tech industry
  • Strong executive presence and ability to foster deep relationships with technical leaders and engineering teams
  • Have at least a high level familiarity with the architecture and operation of large language models and/or ML in general
  • Experience with prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, and architecting AI-powered systems
  • Make ambiguous problems clear and identify core principles that can translate across scenarios
  • Have a passion for making powerful technology safe and societally beneficial
  • Think creatively about the risks and benefits of new technologies, and think beyond past checklists and playbooks
  • Stay up-to-date and informed by taking an active interest in emerging research and industry trends
  • Understanding of developer tooling, SDKs, and technical integration patterns common in enterprise tech companies

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Engineering Manager, Guardian
description:
About the Team

The Guardian team builds practical safety and oversight systems for increasingly capable AI agents. Our goal is to make it possible for agents to take on longer-running, higher-autonomy work while preserving meaningful safeguards, respecting user intent, and intervening when actions could cause serious or difficult-to-reverse harm.

Auto-review is an early example of this work. When an agent reaches a permission boundary, a separate model evaluates the proposed action in context and determines whether it should proceed. The team is now extending this foundation into more capable oversight systems that account for richer user context, support a broader range of agent experiences, and integrate across OpenAI products.

Guardian sits at the intersection of engineering, alignment research, product, infrastructure, and security. The team already has a strong engineering foundation in London and will continue to grow there as a concentrated, highly collaborative group.

About the Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead and grow the Guardian team in London. You will own the engineering strategy and execution for production systems that evaluate agent behavior, identify risk, and take appropriate action without creating unnecessary friction for users.

This is a builder-manager role with substantial technical depth. You will set direction, develop engineers, and create the operating cadence for a high-performing team, while remaining close enough to the work to shape architecture, review designs, debug difficult problems, and write code when it is the highest-leverage way to help the team move forward.

The role is highly visible and cross-functional. You will work closely with alignment researchers to translate emerging research into dependable systems, and with product teams to make agent safety a foundational capability across OpenAI.

This role is based in our London office.

In this role, you will

  • Lead, hire, and develop a London-based team of engineers working across agent safety, backend systems, applied AI, and product infrastructure.

  • Set the technical roadmap for Auto-review and the broader Guardian platform, balancing safety, product utility, latency, and operational reliability.

  • Build production systems that evaluate agent actions in real time, detect potentially harmful behavior, and support safe recovery or escalation paths.

  • Improve how oversight systems understand user intent, environmental context, permissions, and relevant personalization signals while protecting privacy and avoiding unnecessary friction.

  • Partner closely with alignment researchers to turn prototypes, evaluations, and new monitoring techniques into scalable product capabilities.

  • Work across Product, Security, Infrastructure, and other engineering teams to integrate Guardian capabilities into agent experiences throughout OpenAI.

  • Establish rigorous evaluation and operational practices, including adversarial testing, failure analysis, monitoring, and metrics for safety performance, false positives, latency, and user impact.

  • Have significant experience leading engineering teams that shipped complex, high-stakes production systems end to end.

  • Have built with AI agents or large language models in a core product, startup, or technically serious independent project, and understand the unique challenges of agentic systems.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
About Lemon.io

Lemon.io is a profitable, growing talent marketplace that connects vetted senior engineers with companies that need them. We’ve been in business for 10 years, have 60 people across Ukraine, Europe, Canada, and the US, and process over $16M in annual GMV. We compress the traditional 2–5 week hiring timeline down to 24–48 hours through a curated, pre-vetted supply of developers.

Hiring is still broken. Recruiters spend weeks building candidate pipelines on traditional platforms, burning energy on unqualified leads. We’re building the product that changes that. Giving recruiters qualified, vetted candidates within 24 hours without the grind. This is a pivotal moment: we’re transitioning from a services-driven marketplace to a technology-driven platform. We need an engineering leader who can drive that transformation.

The Role

You will own engineering at Lemon.io. You’ll lead a growing team of engineers, make critical architecture and prioritization decisions, and be directly accountable for the speed and quality of what we ship. This is not a management-layer role. You’ll be hands-on, deeply involved in product decisions, and working side by side with the founder.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical roadmap and make sure every engineering effort maps directly to business impact. No features for features’ sake.

  • Lead and grow an engineering team that ships fast, iterates constantly, and treats complexity as a cost.

  • Tackle the hard, multi-layered problem: automated vetting, intelligent matching at scale, demand-side bottlenecks. And figure out where the real leverage is.

  • Make hard prioritization calls. Decide what we build, what we skip, and what we kill.

  • Work directly with the founder and product team to define what success looks like before writing a single line of code.

  • Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy.

Who You Are:

  • Product-minded, business-first

  • Obsessed with simplicity

  • First principles thinker
